answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers for liquid cooling at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of new capacity pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards (company-stated; original_day not given). It targets US$80-US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 (a company target, not a result). Also: NN removed from the Russell Microcap Value Index in late June 2026. The US$485.5m revenue and US$47.9m earnings by 2028 figures are a Simply Wall St style narrative projection, and the US$489.5m/US$48.3m figures are from unnamed analysts (rumour tier); neither matches a covered NVDA question. NN is outside the covered scope (NVDA only), and no stored pieces or catalog questions exist to update. Mismatch: NN's Wuxi capacity is a supplier-side datapoint, not NVIDIA's own revenue, capex or shipments.
